title: Hifdh check: Al-Insan and recitation (half term): rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y9 lesson 51 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Hifdh check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 51. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا (٢٧) نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا (٢٨) إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا (٢٩) وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا (٣٠) يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا (٣١)

questions.q: Hifdh check: today's group recites Al-Insan to the teacher against the rubric. Everyone else: rota revision and targets.
Extend: recite Al-Qiyamah 1 to 15 from the rota.
Think again: Al-Mursalat (77) is next, then Juz' Tabarak is complete. What will you change in your routine to finish strongly?
questions.a: For example: an extra 5 minutes of sabaq daily, or reciting new ayat in sunnah prayers.
